paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua bar Zeidel asked Rabbi Yannai be-Rabbi Yishmael; they went up to Rabbi Yannai—Rabbi Zeira, Rabbi Hoshaya, Rabbi Bun bar Kahana, and Rabbi Chananyah (Terumot 8:5 and Jerusalem Talmud, Avodah Zarah 2:2).
